people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
translations.bsb: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”
translations.kjv: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.
translations.asv: And as Jesus passed by from thence, two blind men followed him, crying out, and saying, Have mercy on us, thou son of David.
